cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The caretaker's asking about our extra key. Tell him we were checking the cake cupboard's lock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We did check it. Then we ate the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Start with the part we both remember as maintenance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll ask why there are crumbs in the lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we both remember a blockage. Say that back so we're consistent.

mechanism: A treats its former tasting pupil as a witness to coach into repeating one account, conceding its own role to secure corroboration.
confusable: Not private concealment alone: A wants a shared answer that B can repeat to the person asking about the eaten cake.
comparison: Deflecting collision chronology versus agreeing who initiated an unauthorized tasting.
